summary: Kimberly Moore, 42, drowned while paddleboarding on the Colorado River near the 5th Street Bridge in Grand Junction; a group of 6 on a paddleboard, kayak, and raft got into trouble after hitting debris, five self-rescued to an island, and Moore was found unconscious and not breathing by the rescue boat
location: Colorado River near the 5th Street Bridge, Grand Junction
responding_agency: Mesa County Sheriff's Office; Mesa County Search and Rescue; Grand Junction Fire Department; Grand Junction Police Department
notes: Grand Junction Daily Sentinel/CPR detail: not wearing a life jacket; on the paddleboard with a non-breakaway leash. Incident date Wednesday 2022-06-15 per CPR.
